description: Annotation-backed mechanosensory map for the body feedback adapter and reusable MaleCNS drive contract. Counts are resolved from the local CSR when available; no neuron/body IDs are stored.

drive_mapping.description: Explicit hand-built population drives for the reusable MaleCNS adapter. Values are signed normalized drives; gains are bounded current injections, not neuron or body-ID mappings.

jo.provenance: Bounded JO wind/gravity proxy; annotation selectors resolve the population, but no per-afferent or body-ID tuning is asserted.

haltere.provenance: Bounded angular-rate haltere proxy; no per-afferent or body-ID tuning is asserted.

wing.provenance: Bounded aggregate wing tactile/proprioceptive proxy; aggregate input takes precedence over component aliases.

wing_tactile.provenance: Bounded wing tactile proxy used only when the aggregate wing drive is absent.

wing_proprioceptive.provenance: Bounded wing proprioceptive proxy used only when the aggregate wing drive is absent.

leg.provenance: Bounded aggregate leg tactile/proprioceptive proxy; aggregate input takes precedence over component aliases.

leg_tactile.provenance: Bounded leg tactile proxy used only when the aggregate leg drive is absent.

leg_proprioceptive.provenance: Bounded leg proprioceptive proxy used only when the aggregate leg drive is absent.

jo_wind_gravity.provenance: MaleCNS labels subclass:wind_gravity as Johnston's-organ wind/gravity afferents; class/subclass intersection resolves 475 in the local CSR.
jo_wind_gravity.mapping_provenance: Wind projection and body-tilt law is a hand-built adapter; the connectome annotation does not supply a one-to-one body-to-afferent tuning map.

jo.provenance: Alias of the verified JO wind/gravity selector; no additional population is claimed.

wind_gravity.provenance: Alias of the verified JO wind/gravity selector; no additional population is claimed.

haltere.provenance: MaleCNS class/subclass intersection resolves 201 mechanosensory proprioceptive haltere cells in the local CSR; the four other subclass:haltere records are annotated unknown_sensory and are excluded.
haltere.mapping_provenance: Angular-rate law is a hand-built proxy for haltere feedback; no body IDs or per-cell tuning are asserted.

wing_tactile.provenance: The verified tactile wing selector used by the reference SensoryEncoders is class:mechanosensory_tactile&nerve:ADMN; it resolves 352 in the local CSR.
wing_tactile.mapping_provenance: Wing phase/imbalance law is a hand-built population proxy, not a measured per-neuron transfer function.

wing_proprioceptive.provenance: MaleCNS class/subclass intersection resolves the annotated wing proprioceptive group (19 cells) in the local CSR.
wing_proprioceptive.mapping_provenance: Wing phase law is synthetic and carries no body-ID correspondence.

wing.provenance: Union of the verified wing tactile ADMN group (352) and wing proprioceptive group (19); no broader nerve:ADMN count is treated as a pure mechanosensory population.
wing.mapping_provenance: Wing phase/imbalance law is a hand-built population proxy, not a measured per-neuron transfer function.

wing_mechanosensory.provenance: Alias for the verified mechanosensory_tactile ADMN group; the broader nerve:ADMN count is not treated as a pure mechanosensory population.

leg_tactile.provenance: MaleCNS reference mapping identifies ProLN/MesoLN/MetaLN as the three leg nerves; the class-filtered union resolves 1877 tactile cells in the local CSR.
leg_tactile.mapping_provenance: Ground-contact law is a hand-built bilateral proxy; it does not identify individual legs or body IDs.

leg_proprioceptive.provenance: MaleCNS class/subclass intersection resolves the annotated leg proprioceptive group (190 cells) in the local CSR.
leg_proprioceptive.mapping_provenance: Ground-contact law is synthetic; no one-to-one leg or body-ID mapping is asserted.

leg.provenance: Union of the verified leg tactile group (1877) and leg proprioceptive group (190); generic subclass:leg counts are not used.
leg.mapping_provenance: Ground-contact law is a hand-built bilateral proxy; it does not identify individual legs or body IDs.

leg_mechanosensory.provenance: Alias for the class-filtered leg tactile selector; generic subclass:leg counts are not used because they include unknown and chemosensory records.

excluded_annotations.reason: The local MaleCNS records are class:gustatory, not mechanosensory_tactile; omitted from this mechanosensory-only map.
The local MaleCNS records are class:gustatory, not mechanosensory_tactile; omitted from this mechanosensory-only map.
The unfiltered subclass includes unknown_sensory and chemosensory records; class-filtered tactile/proprioceptive groups are used instead.
